plan.title: RFQ to Auction Availability by Plan

args.need: provide access or company IDs for one below-Growth tenant and one Growth tenant, then run the same published RFQ conversion availability check on both tenants

steps.note: Cross-tenant plan selection and comparison cannot be performed without the specified tenant identities or access.
Closest available assertion for the below-Growth tenant: the conversion action should be absent, but it cannot run against the intended tenant until access is provided.
Closest available assertion for the Growth tenant: the conversion action should be offered, but the catalog cannot switch to the intended Growth tenant without its identity.
